**Version 1.0.2 - Major Feature & Documentation Update**

- Expanded feature set with advanced options: keyword optimization, ROI prediction, emoji/hashtag generation, and automated delivery (email/Telegram).
- Enhanced documentation: much more detailed SKILL.md including use cases, advanced API examples, configurable parameters, and expanded ad style explanations.
- Clearer ClawHub pricing details now listed.
- New supporting files: pricing info, publishing checklist, and evaluation report added.
- Code updates in key scripts and API reference to support new features and documentation consistency.

- No changes in code or documentation detected.
- Version and SKILL.md content remain unchanged from previous release.

Initial release of fb-ads-copywriter-pro.

- Generates 6 high-conversion Facebook ad versions (FOMO, social proof, authority, pain point, promotion, storytelling)
- Provides 3 A/B testing suggestions and 3 audience segment analyses
- Includes campaign strategy recommendations (budget allocation, KPI)
- Supports Cantonese ad copywriting
- Ensures compliance with Facebook ad policies
- Offers multiple pricing plans (Free trial, Basic, Advanced, Pro)
- Command-line tool with straightforward installation and configuration instructions
